preconditions.description: The length of the binary representation of l is between 1 and 10^6.
The length of the binary representation of l is equal to the length of the binary representation of r.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in l)
preconditions.description: The binary representation of l consists only of digits 0 and 1.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in r)
preconditions.description: The binary representation of r consists only of digits 0 and 1.
The integer value of l is less than or equal to the integer value of r.

postconditions.description: The output is the binary representation of the maximum XOR value of all subranges from l to r without extra leading zeros.
